header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2024 and was lastly fixed on 07.02.2024, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same which reflects that petitioner is not interested to pursue this petition.
Under these circumstances, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
